doc.title: Monthly Updates [October]
doc.html:
INFO These update threads only contain major updates. If you're interested in seeing all minor changes you can follow our Commits Page on GitHub or Updates Channel in Discord.

Wiki Updates

  • Created a List of Guides on Rentry. This page is automated and updates itself anytime a new Rentry is added or removed from FMHY. You can also download the guides yourself by using this script.

  • Made a Pokémon section in Gaming Tools and an Email section in Internet Tools.

  • Added emojis to indicate when we're linking 3rd party indexes or our storage page:

🌐 = 3rd Party Indexes (i.e., /r/PiratedGames Mega, Awesome Lists, etc.)

↪️ = Storage Links

Stars Added ⭐

  • Starred Nova AI in AI Chatbots. Provides free GPT-4 tokens.

  • Starred BlueROMs in ROM Sites. A simple DDL site with lots of systems.

  • Starred Qiwi in File Hosts. A fast host that is becoming popular in piracy circles.

  • Starred Moo and Media in Video Drives. Fast drives with lots of content.

  • Starred WiiUDownloader in ROM Sites. Updated more frequently than WiiUSBHelper.

  • Starred Time4TV in Live TV. Fast streams and a wide variety of channels.

  • Starred Tampermonkey in Userscript Managers. Updated more frequently than Greasemonkey.

  • Starred PeaZip in File Archivers. Open-source and supports many formats.

  • Starred Miru in Android Streaming. An open-source, multi-format media app.

  • Starred gibMacOS in Mac Tools. Easily download macOS versions.

  • Starred AppsTorrent in Mac Software. A popular Mac software site with many apps.

  • Starred PlayPhrase in Video Tools. Search the entire internet for specific video clips.

  • Starred Magic ToDo in To-Do Apps. An AI-powered automatic task breakdown tool.

  • Starred SafeSubstance in Health. Provides drug information and side effects.

  • Starred TinyKittens in General Tools. A kitten rescue and donation website.

Things Removed

  • Removed RSLOAD, as they have uploaded a version of Malwarebytes bundled with the same malware that caused the recent FileCR controversy. We have emailed them; hopefully, they remove it soon so we can re-evaluate.

  • Removed marin.moe from Anime Streaming as it is redirecting to an unrelated domain now.

  • Removed AdGuard Extra and other adblock defenders as they are redundant when using uBlock Origin.

  • Removed SteamSkins as Steam dropped support for them in the latest update.

  • Removed Saikou from Android Anime as their GitHub repository has been DMCA'd.

  • Removed Uptobox from File Hosts as their data center was raided by French police.
